Overview

Semera is a city in Afar with a population of 30,000. The capital of the Afar Region, a gateway to the Danakil Depression, one of the hottest places on Earth. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 320 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
